mapper.select: SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(1500) */ COUNT(*) AS pending, COALESCE(MAX(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))),0) AS oldest_seconds, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX((held_amount+booked_amount)/limit_amount),0) FROM usage_account WHERE state IN ('ACTIVE','FROZEN')) AS budget_ratio, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usage_account WHERE state IN ('ACTIVE','FROZEN')) AS accounts, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,updated_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))),0) FROM usage_attempt WHERE state IN ('DISPATCHED','UNKNOWN')) AS unknown_seconds FROM ai_task WHERE status='QUEUED'
